notes.title: The [SWAP AND DROP] Beta Update
notes.content:
[u][b]IMPORTANT TO NOTE[/b][/u]
[b]Update 1.3 is a BETA UPDATE, which means this update is only accessed by selecting the open beta branch in the Betas Section and is only for Windows OS'[/b]

[h1]STOP HOARDING YOUR GUNS, DROP THEM, SWAP THEM, OR FEEL THE HEAT[/h1]
The [SWAP AND DROP] Update focuses on revamping heat values and other weapon changes to encourage the switching of guns.

[b]Weapon Changes[/b]
[u]Heat Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Rifle heat gain increased from 0.1 to 0.15
[*] Rifle heat regeneration increased from 0.1 to 0.25
[*] Rifle max heat increased from 2 to 4
[*] Shotgun heat gain increased from 0.25 to 0.5
[*] Shotgun regeneration increased from 0.1 to 0.25
[/list]
[u]Pickup Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Guns now reload when picking them up
[*] Added outlines to gun pickups
[*] Players can no longer pick up a gun they already have
[*] Changed various equip animations to make them more smooth
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Gun pickups can no longer be thrown through the floor
[/list]

[u][b]THE MINIGUN[/b][/u]
[u]Complete rework of the minigun[/u]
[list]
[*] Minigun now charges up then releases a burst of bullets all at once
[*] Charge takes 3 seconds and can be alleviated by reloading the minigun, which takes a further 3 seconds
[*] Heat can be seen around the minigun as it is charging and after it fires
[/list]

[b]Enemy Changes[/b]
[u]Health Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Rifle Enemy health decreased from 30 to 20
[*] Shotgun Enemy health decreased from 20 to 10
[*] Minigun Enemy health decreased from 50 to 30
[*] Basic Enemy health decreased from 10 to 5
[/list]
[u]Other Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Grappling to enemies speed changed from 75 mps to 50 mps
[*] Minigun and Shotgun Enemy corpses added 
[/list]

[b]Standard Bug/Oversight Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bounce pads boosting inconsistent heights
[*] Fixed letting go of healing early causing the wrong heartbeat sound to be played
[*] Fixed the vent not falling in Advanced Weaponry
[*] Fixed lava blocking the pipe at the end of Paranoir
[/list]

notes.title: The UNIVERSAL TESTING Update
notes.content:
[h1]MAC AND LINUX SUPPORT IS HERE[/h1]
Jump into the chambers on new operating systems!

[h2]Build 1.2 | Changes and Updates[/h2]

[b]Additions/Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Models and Animations to Machine Gun Enemies
[*] Added Shooting SFX to Shotgun Enemies
[*] Added Fading Music
[*] Added [i]Sawmill[/i] (Headless Feller Boss Music) to the End of [i]Up Close and Personal[/i]
[*] Added a Checkpoint After the Catwalk in [i]Paranoir[/i]
[*] Added Heartbeat Sounds When Healing and While in the Double Damage State
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Patches[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Changed Music Not Staying Changed When Respawning (Specifically In [i]Paranoir[/i])
[/list]

notes.title: Bug and Oversight Fixes | Patch 1.1 Released
notes.content:
Multiple Bug Fixes and other problems fixed

[list]
[*] Players are now able to respawn more than once
[*] Enemies can no longer shoot through walls
[*] Added killzones/lava to multiple areas lacking them
[*] Added dash indicators in levels 2 and 3 and slanted ceilings at the landing zones of said dashes
[*] Added more force to Rifle Enemies slide 
[*] Shotgun Nerfed: Heat accumulation increased to 0.25 from 0.1 and Regeneration factor increased from 0.01 to 0.1
[*] Rifle damage increased from 3 to 5 per shot
[*] Weapons now able to be picked up from right next to them
[*] Controls now listed in the general section of Options
[*] Enemies now die when falling in lava
[/list]

notes.title: Controls
notes.content:
WASD: Movement
E: pickup guns
Q (hold): heal
Shift (press): Short dash
Shift (hold) : Long Dash
Ctrl (hold while moving): slide
1: Pistol
2: Primary
Right Click (hold while looking at pink spheres): Grapple
Left Click: Shoot
R: Reload
F: Punch
